purpose: Teach: 打倒/降伏/介在/適法/内在/剥奪/受刑/労働党

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界一位を打倒する目標を持て
lines.en: We need to set our sights on overtaking the industry leader.
lines.style: Calm, commanding. Measured delivery with weight behind each phrase. Direct eye contact. Voice sits low and steady — no doubt in the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合に降伏する選択肢はございません
lines.en: Understood. There's no option for us to surrender to the competition.
lines.style: Formal, attentive. Clipped precision on key words. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Respectful but not obsequious — matching the boss's steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正に介在する取引先には対応しろ
lines.en: And for any business partners engaging in improper conduct — we need to act.
lines.style: Directive, no-nonsense. Slight pause before the dash. Hard consonant on 'act.' Leans forward slightly. This is where the ethics matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内手続きは適法を徹底しております
lines.en: Understood. We maintain strict adherence to proper procedure in all internal dealings.
lines.style: Reassuring competence. Steady rhythm. Emphasis on 'strict' — showing it's already integrated. Professional, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に内在する不満を吸い上げろ
lines.en: Listen to what your people are actually feeling. Draw out their real concerns.
lines.style: Softer than before — almost advisory now. Slower pace. Genuine interest beneath the authority. This is where wisdom shows, not just command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不正役員の資格剥奪を委員会で検討します
lines.en: Understood. We'll have the committee review the removal of any executives with misconduct on record.
lines.style: Formal, decisive. 'Review' lands with purpose. Businesslike but not cold — this action is necessary and he knows it. Slight firmness under the courtesy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が受刑者になった場合の支援を考えろ
lines.en: And if any of our people face legal trouble — we support them through it.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Longer breath. This statement carries moral weight. Pause before 'we support' — it's a choice, not a policy. The room understands the significance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働党との対話の窓口も開いております
lines.en: Understood. We've already opened dialogue with the labor representatives to prepare.
lines.style: Focused, matter-of-fact closure. 'Prepare' trails slightly, signaling readiness without fanfare. Brief, competent. The conversation's natural end point.
